motifs.name: left_foreground_tree_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the dense grove at the far left foreground: gnarled leaning trunks, dark clustered foliage, bare upper branches, hanging willow-like strands, low shrubs, and the small rocky earth base beneath the trees. Exclude the pavilion, fence, and neighboring central willow mass.
must_preserve: ink-wash ground mounds and small rock dots

motifs.name: pavilion_with_reclining_scholar
motifs.description: Isolate the open garden pavilion and enclosure: sloping roof or awning, upright posts, interior couch with a reclining scholar, and the angled lattice fence below. Avoid surrounding tree canopies except where they directly overlap the pavilion silhouette.
must_preserve: precise roof geometry and eave lines
reclining scholar outline and robe strokes
light interior wash and platform edges

motifs.description: Isolate the large central willow cluster rising from the middle bank, with multiple intertwined trunks and heavy curtains of drooping leaves. Exclude pavilion details, foreground rocks, and distant shore where possible.
must_preserve: layered gray wash behind leaf masses
root flare and lower trunk texture
